title: FitSquad Phase 1 data model and API contract
description: Define the Phase 1 data model and API structure for packages, reservations, payment status, and basic availability enforcement. Keep the model intentionally minimal and aligned to manual business operations. The output should be implementation-ready and should not introduce contracts, invoicing, CRM entities, or advanced reporting.
acceptance_criteria: define the minimum core entities required for Phase 1
define the reservation state and payment status fields needed for deposit or full payment tracking
define the minimum public and admin API endpoints required for Phase 1
show how basic capacity enforcement prevents overbooking
